title: lem sf verdier ordinary tensor transport
statement: Let S be a six-functor operation datum, s a coefficient stage, f:X→Y and g:Y→Z separated finite-type maps, and fix compactifications cf,cg,cx and restricted finite-Tor presentations Rf,Rg,Rx for f,g,fg. Suppose Rf.closedX=Rx.closedX. For a finite-Tor object M on X, objects N,T on Z and z:T→Qx H_X(M,Gx N), let b be the inverse f tensor-Hom transpose of the successive inverse ordinary transposes of z followed by sourceCoordinate. Then the inverse composite tensor-Hom transpose of its inverse ordinary transpose, transported from Rf's tensor to Rx's by tensorCoordinate, followed by exceptionalComposition, equals (1_M tensor pullComposition_T) followed by b. All compositors are the canonical right-adjoint mates defined in the coordinate node. This concerns only ordinary inverse transposition and tensor-Hom inverse on X; no projection or exceptional inverse transpose occurs.

proof.text: Apply inverse ordinary Hom equivalence to rightAdjointUniq. Source naturality and homEquiv_symm_rightAdjointUniq_hom_app identify it with the original inverse ordinary transpose. The transported composite adjunction expands to pullComposition followed by the two successive inverse ordinary transposes.

proof.text: Identify the two closed data on X by their equality. Target naturality of tensor-Hom inverse moves the exceptional compositor through that transpose; source naturality then moves pullComposition through it. Substitute the first step to obtain the displayed formula.

theorem ordinary_tensor_transport
    (hX : Rf.closedX = Rx.closedX)
    (M : (PodCoefficientStage.domain S s X).FullSubcategory)
    (N T : (PodCoefficientStage.domain S s Z).FullSubcategory)
    (z : T ⟶ (PodHomChain.sourceFunctor S s (f ≫ g) cx Rx M).obj N) :
    (tensorCoordinate S s hX M (Rx.pull.obj T)).hom ≫
        ((Rx.tensorAdjunctionX M).homEquiv _ _).symm
          ((Rx.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv T _).symm z) ≫
        (exceptionalComposition S s f g cf cg cx Rf Rg Rx).hom.app N =
      (tensorLeft Rf.closedX.closed.monoidal M).map
          ((pullComposition S s f g cf cg cx Rf Rg Rx).hom.app T) ≫
        ((Rf.tensorAdjunctionX M).homEquiv _ _).symm
          ((Rf.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv _ _).symm
            ((Rg.ordinaryAdjunction.homEquiv T _).symm
              (z ≫ (sourceCoordinate S s f g cf cg cx Rf Rg Rx M N).hom)))
